title: Countdown timer
prompt: A timer has time_left seconds to go. Return the time left after this frame, but never less than zero.
signature: func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return time_left - delta
hint: Subtract, then stop it going negative: an if, or max() with zero.
solution:
func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return max(time_left - delta, 0.0)
